confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Nice, not live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is the least certain because July is peak season on the Riviera and rates vary widely by location, date and booking window. The FX value comes from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au that I did not open directly; the 15 Oct figure (0.6955) appeared in two snippets, and the 16 Oct figure is from one.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on coastal French Riviera and similar high-demand Mediterranean tourist cities (e.g., Cannes, Antibes, Monaco-adjacent areas) with a July peak-season premium for accommodation and terrace dining; restaurant and drink prices follow typical Nice café and bistro pricing in euros converted at a roughly stable EUR/USD level.
